provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Ticket to Ride rules (Days of Wonder, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player: 45 Train Cars and a Scoring Marker on Start
Shuffle the Train Car cards and deal {n} to each player; turn 5 faceup by the deck
Longest Path Bonus card faceup by the board
Deal 3 Destination Tickets each: keep at least 2, return the rest to the bottom of the deck
The most experienced traveler goes first, then clockwise
